Maria (Docs): Heads-up — we're publishing py-client v2.0 next week with API changes and a built-in compatibility shim. Please read timeline and migration notes below.
Sam (Py SDK): TL;DR: `request.model` -> `request.model_id`, and `temperature` -> `temp`. We added a shim that maps old names but it's opt-in via env var.
Maria (Docs): Yep. Migration steps: 1) try `pip install redwood-py==2.0b1` 2) run tests with `REDWOOD_PY_MIGRATE=true` 3) fix any explicit `.model` uses. I'll paste snippet: 
Sam (Py SDK): ```python
# old
resp = client.generate(model="gpt-small", temperature=0.7)
# new
resp = client.generate(model_id="gpt-small", temp=0.7)
```
Devon (Platform): What's the deprecation window for 1.x? Our Dedicated customers need time.
Maria (Docs): Plan: 60 days soft deprecation (warnings + opt-in shim), 120 days removal. Announce in hosted console and email enterprise customers. Rolling docs update today.
Jin (Product): Any telemetry we should surface in Console? e.g., percent of calls using shim?
Sam (Py SDK): Yes — we'll emit header `x-rw-py-shim: 1` for shimmed calls.
Elena (QA): Can we get a test matrix doc? I can run compatibility tests across 1.x and 2.0.
Maria (Docs): Added checklist: docs PR (#422), sample repo update, deprecation banner, migration guide. @Elena I'll assign compatibility matrix. @Devon we'll coordinate enterprise comms.
OpsBot: deploy:docs-worker succeeded for branch `docs/pypi-v2` — 5 files updated :rocket: 
Devon (Platform): Noted, I'll sync with support and sched an Ops blurb.
Sam (Py SDK): If folks hit runtime errors, set `REDWOOD_PY_MIGRATE=true` to enable shim, file a bug with stack + reproduction.
Maria (Docs): Thanks all. I'll publish a short "what changed" and a migration checklist by EOD. Ping me for urgent edge cases. :white_check_mark:
